functions.name: buildSeasonCatalog
params:
{
  client,
  year,
  now = new Date(),
  meetingLimit,
  log = () => {},
}

callGraph.callee:
top3Raw
    .filter((r) => r.position !== null && r.position <= 3 && r.position >= 1)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.position as number) - (b.position as number))
    .map
